title: Interleaved ADC
text: Time-interleaved ADC model, 4 inputs, 2 outputs, {Input range} sets ADC dynamic range [-1; {Number of bits} sets the number of physical output bits for all ADC, {Linearly interpolate analog input to find sampled value} sets the sub-sample interpolation with sinusoidal conversion start, {Number of ADCs (N)} sets the number of ADC cores to interleave, {Match output to input scale} sets the inherit output polarity and data type, {Output polarity} Defines ADC output polarity, {Output data type} Defines ADC output data, {Convert the output to scalar} sets the convert output to scalar, {Sample time} sets the fixed-step sample rate 6.25e-12, {Simulate using} defines how to simulate ADC, {Enable linearity impairments}, {Offset error} sets the shifts quantization steps by specific value, {Gain error} sets the error on slope of ADC transfer curve, {Enable timing impairments}, {Conversion delay (seconds)} sets the latency of ADC, {Enable offset calibration port} and {Enable gain calibration port}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Number of bits
params.values: Number of physical output bits for all ADC cores 8 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Input range
params.values: ADC dynamic range [-1 1] (default) | 2-element row vector | [ NADCs x 2] matrix

params.name: Linearly interpolate analog input to find sampled value
params.values: Sub-sample interpolation with sinusoidal conversion start signal off (default) | on

params.values: Number of ADC cores to interleave 4 (default) | positive real integer

params.name: Match output to input scale
params.values: Inherit output polarity and data type from input off (default) | on

params.name: Output polarity
params.values: Defines ADC output polarity Auto (default) | Bipolar | Unipolar
